summary: Tested the 'Scaduti' summary and the 'Promemoria inviati' (sent reminders) log in Solleciti rate. Backend: 18/18 pytest pass, covering 7 new log tests and the 11 regression tests for installment-reminders. POST /admin/payments/reminders/log returns 401/403 without auth, 403 for a coach, 422 when required fields are missing and 200 for the admin with {ok, sent_at, role}. The DB document has society_id, sent_by and sent_at. GET then shows last_reminder (null, then count 1, then count 2 with the latest role), isolated per athlete and per rata. Frontend at 375x667: rata-tab-overdue is the first tab, selected by default, with badge 3. The red header shows '3 rate scadute' and 'Da incassare: € 400,00'. The list covers all overdue rate sorted by due_date ascending, with a 'Rata N' chip on each row. Sending a reminder calls window.open with wa.me/393201234567 and POSTs the log with the correct body. The modal closes and the row shows 'Sollecitato il 06/11/2026 (Padre)' with the button changed to 'Risollecita'. This persists after reload. The Rata 1/2/3 tabs and the Pagato/Non pagato toggle work and the counts are correct. Two minor issues found: the badge date uses UTC, and the POST log does not validate its input.

minor.issue: No validation: any athlete_id is accepted, including one that does not exist or belongs to another society, and so is any installment_number (99 was accepted with 200). A document is still inserted. The endpoint should check that the athlete belongs to the society and that installment_number is 1, 2 or 3.

ui_bugs.issue: The date comes from lr.sent_at.slice(0,10) on a UTC ISO string. Between 00:00 and 01:00/02:00 Rome time it shows the previous day. Reproduced: a reminder sent at 00:40 Rome time on 07/11 is shown as 'Sollecitato il 06/11/2026'. Fix: format with new Date(sent_at).toLocaleDateString('it-IT', {timeZone:'Europe/Rome'}), or have the backend return a date in Rome time. Ref: app/admin/payments-reminders.tsx:246

issues: refresh-btn is 35x34 and back-btn is 32x36, below the 44x44 minimum touch target (no hitSlop).
In the Scaduti tab, a single athlete with 2 or more overdue rate would render duplicate testIDs wa-<athleteId>. Consider wa-<athleteId>-<rata> for uniqueness.

action_items: Format the 'Sollecitato il' date in the Europe/Rome timezone instead of slicing the UTC ISO string (payments-reminders.tsx:246).
POST reminders/log: check that the athlete belongs to the society (404 otherwise) and constrain installment_number to 1..3 (Field(ge=1, le=3)).
Optional: give back-btn and refresh-btn a 44x44 touch area (hitSlop or padding), and make the wa- testIDs unique per rata.
critical_code_review_comments: The log is written after Linking.openURL succeeds and does not block if it fails. That is good, but on failure the user gets no feedback, so a reminder could go unrecorded without anyone noticing.
payment_reminders documents have no 'id' field (only Mongo _id), unlike the other collections. This does not cause any _id leak in responses.

All were deleted by id afterwards. Checked: 0 TEST_ records and 0 payment_reminders left. No real data was touched and no real WhatsApp messages were sent (window.open was stubbed and wa.me blocked).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Seed with 'python /app/backend/tests/seed_test_reminders.py seed' and remove with '... cleanup' (cleanup also removes payment_reminders). Run pytest with EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL exported from frontend/.env. The preview is a static dist build. To intercept WhatsApp, use add_init_script to override window.open and route **/wa.me/** to abort. The login screen has no testIDs: use the placeholders Email/Password and the text 'Accedi'.
